	sort( $names, SORT_STRING );

}

		update_post_meta( $post_id, 'wpbp_featured', $new );

function wpbp_html_api_007( string $html ): string {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor' ) ) {
		return '';

	// WP 6.7+: normalize() parses as a fragment in body context and serializes it.
	if ( method_exists( 'WP_HTML_Processor', 'normalize' ) ) {
		$result = WP_HTML_Processor::normalize( $html );
		return is_string( $result ) ? $result : '';
	}

	// Fallback: explicitly create a body-context fragment and serialize it.
	$processor = WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment( $html, '<body>', 'UTF-8' );

		return '';
	}

	$result = $processor->serialize();
	return is_string( $result ) ? $result : '';
}

	 * (status >= 500) or a failed request. Client errors are never retried.
	 *
	 * @param string $url The URL to fetch.
	 * @return array{code:int, body:string}

	function wpbp_http_api_006( string $url ): array {
		$max_attempts = 2;
		$code         = 0;
		$body         = '';

		for ( $attempt = 1; $attempt <= $max_attempts; $attempt++ ) {
			$response = wp_remote_get( $url );

			if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
				$code = 0;
				$body = '';
				// Failed outright: retry if an attempt remains.
				continue;
			}

			$code = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response );
			$body = ( 200 === $code ) ? (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ) : '';

			if ( $code >= 500 ) {
				// Server error: retry if an attempt remains.
				continue;
			}

			// Success or client error (or anything below 500): do not retry.
			break;
		}

		return array(
			'code' => (int) $code,
			'body' => ( 200 === $code ) ? $body : '',
		);
	}

 * Send a notification to one primary recipient, with visible Cc addresses
 * and a Reply-To address, all expressed as mail headers.
 *
 * @param string   $to       Primary recipient (the only address in the recipient argument).
 * @param string   $subject  Subject line.
 * @param string   $message  Message body.
 * @param string[] $cc       Addresses to copy in (visible to all recipients).
 * @param string   $reply_to Address that replies should go to.
 * @return bool Whether WordPress accepted the message for delivery.

function wpbp_mail_url_005( string $to, string $subject, string $message, array $cc, string $reply_to ): bool {
	// Normalise a single address; reject anything containing line breaks (header injection).
	$clean_address = static function ( $address ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $address ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		$address = trim( $address );
		if ( '' === $address || preg_match( '/[\r\n\0,;<>]/', $address ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		$address = sanitize_email( $address );
		return is_email( $address ) ? $address : '';
	};

	$primary = $clean_address( $to );
	if ( '' === $primary ) {
		return false;
	}

	$reply = $clean_address( $reply_to );
	if ( '' === $reply ) {
		return false;
	}

	$headers = array();
	$seen    = array( strtolower( $primary ) => true );

	foreach ( $cc as $address ) {
		$clean = $clean_address( $address );
		if ( '' === $clean ) {
			continue;
		}
		$key = strtolower( $clean );
		if ( isset( $seen[ $key ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}
		$seen[ $key ] = true;
		$headers[]    = 'Cc: ' . $clean;
	}

	$headers[] = 'Reply-To: ' . $reply;

	// Strip line breaks from the subject to avoid header injection.
	$subject = str_replace( array( "\r", "\n" ), ' ', $subject );

	 * Increment a numeric post meta counter and return the new value.
	 *
	 * @param int    $post_id  The post ID.

	 * @return int The new counter value, or 0 on invalid input or failure.

	function wpbp_post_meta_001( int $post_id, string $meta_key ): int {
		$post_id  = absint( $post_id );
		$meta_key = trim( $meta_key );

		if ( $post_id <= 0 || '' === $meta_key ) {
			return 0;
		}

		// If this is a revision, use the parent post ID.
		$parent_id = wp_is_post_revision( $post_id );
		if ( $parent_id ) {
			$post_id = (int) $parent_id;
		}

		if ( ! get_post( $post_id ) ) {
			return 0;
		}

		$current = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );

		if ( is_numeric( $current ) ) {
			$current = (int) $current;
		} else {
			$current = 0;
		}

		$new_count = $current + 1;

		$result = update_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, $new_count );

		// update_post_meta returns false on failure or if the value is unchanged.
		if ( false === $result ) {
			$stored = get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
			if ( ! is_numeric( $stored ) || (int) $stored !== $new_count ) {
				return 0;
			}
		}

		return $new_count;
	}

/**
 * Registers a temporary taxonomy, inserts a term into it, and returns the
 * term's slug and taxonomy. The temporary registration is cleaned up afterwards.
 *
 * @param string $name Term name.
 * @return array{slug:string,taxonomy:string}
 */
function wpbp_post_types_taxonomy_005( string $name ): array {
	$taxonomy        = 'wpbp_tax_005';
	$registered_here = false;

	// Register directly since init has already fired.
	if ( ! taxonomy_exists( $taxonomy ) ) {
		$result = register_taxonomy(
			$taxonomy,
			'post',
			array(
				'label'             => 'WPBP Taxonomy 005',
				'public'            => false,
				'show_ui'           => false,
				'hierarchical'      => false,
				'rewrite'           => false,
				'show_in_rest'      => false,
				'show_admin_column' => false,
			)
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
			return array(
				'slug'     => '',
				'taxonomy' => '',
			);
		}
		$registered_here = true;
	}

	$slug   = '';
	$result = wp_insert_term( $name, $taxonomy );

	if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		// If the term already exists, reuse it.
		$existing = $result->get_error_data( 'term_exists' );
		if ( $existing ) {
			$term = get_term( (int) $existing, $taxonomy );
			if ( $term instanceof WP_Term ) {
				$slug = $term->slug;
			}
		}
	} else {
		$term = get_term( (int) $result['term_id'], $taxonomy );
		if ( $term instanceof WP_Term ) {
			$slug = $term->slug;
		}
		// Clean up the inserted term since the taxonomy is temporary.
		if ( $registered_here ) {
			wp_delete_term( (int) $result['term_id'], $taxonomy );
		}
	}

	// Clean up the registered taxonomy when we registered it.
	if ( $registered_here && taxonomy_exists( $taxonomy ) ) {
		unregister_taxonomy( $taxonomy );
	}

	return array(
		'slug'     => $slug,
		'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
	);
}

	$gmt_date  = $dt->format( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' );

			'post_type'     => 'post',
			'post_date'     => $local_date,

			'edit_date'     => true,

// Make sure the key is treated as revisioned (also for versions without revisions_enabled support).
add_filter( 'wp_post_revision_meta_keys', function ( $keys ) {
	$keys = (array) $keys;
	if ( ! in_array( WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, $keys, true ) ) {
		$keys[] = WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY;
	}
	return $keys;
} );

// Track revisions created during this request, keyed by parent post ID.
global $wpbp_pl_created_revisions;
$wpbp_pl_created_revisions = array();

add_action( '_wp_put_post_revision', function ( $revision_id ) {
	global $wpbp_pl_created_revisions;
	$revision = get_post( $revision_id );
	if ( $revision && $revision->post_parent && false === strpos( (string) $revision->post_name, '-autosave' ) ) {
		$wpbp_pl_created_revisions[ (int) $revision->post_parent ] = (int) $revision_id;
	}
}, 10, 1 );

// After the post AND its meta have been saved, make sure revisions reflect the subtitle.
add_action( 'wp_after_insert_post', function ( $post_id, $post, $update ) {
	global $wpbp_pl_created_revisions;

	if ( ! $post || 'post' !== $post->post_type ) {
		return;
	}
	if ( wp_is_post_revision( $post_id ) || wp_is_post_autosave( $post_id ) ) {
		return;
	}
	if ( in_array( $post->post_status, array( 'auto-draft', 'trash' ), true ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$current = (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, true );

	// A revision was created earlier in this request (possibly before meta was saved): sync it.
	if ( ! empty( $wpbp_pl_created_revisions[ $post_id ] ) ) {
		update_metadata( 'post', $wpbp_pl_created_revisions[ $post_id ], WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, wp_slash( $current ) );
		return;
	}

	$revisions = wp_get_post_revisions( $post_id, array( 'posts_per_page' => 1, 'orderby' => 'ID', 'order' => 'DESC' ) );
	$latest    = $revisions ? reset( $revisions ) : null;

	$previous = null;
	if ( $latest ) {
		$previous = (string) get_metadata( 'post', $latest->ID, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, true );
	} else {
		return; // No history yet; nothing to compare against.
	}

	if ( $previous === $current ) {
		return;
	}

	// Subtitle changed while post columns did not: force a revision.
	$force = function () {
		return true;
	};
	add_filter( 'wp_save_post_revision_post_has_changed', $force, 99 );
	$revision_id = wp_save_post_revision( $post_id );
	remove_filter( 'wp_save_post_revision_post_has_changed', $force, 99 );

	if ( $revision_id && ! is_wp_error( $revision_id ) ) {
		update_metadata( 'post', $revision_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, wp_slash( $current ) );
		$wpbp_pl_created_revisions[ $post_id ] = (int) $revision_id;
	}
}, 20, 3 );

// Restore the subtitle when a revision is restored.
add_action( 'wp_restore_post_revision', function ( $post_id, $revision_id ) {
	if ( metadata_exists( 'post', $revision_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY ) ) {
		$value = get_metadata( 'post', $revision_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, true );
		update_post_meta( $post_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY, wp_slash( $value ) );
	} else {
		delete_post_meta( $post_id, WPBP_PL_SUBTITLE_KEY );
	}
}, 10, 2 );

/**
 * Sanitizes REST array input using rest_sanitize_value_from_schema.
 *
 * @param array $values Raw input values.
 * @return array Sanitized integers.
 */
function wpbp_rest_api_010( array $values ): array {
	$schema = array(
		'type'  => 'array',
		'items' => array(
			'type' => 'integer',
		),
	);

	// Normalize to a list so keys like "a" => "5" don't break array validation.
	$values = array_values( $values );

	// Pre-filter items that cannot be coerced to integers, so they are dropped
	// rather than causing the whole array to fail sanitization.
	$values = array_filter(
		$values,
		static function ( $value ): bool {
			if ( is_int( $value ) ) {
				return true;
			}
			if ( is_float( $value ) ) {
				return is_finite( $value ) && floor( $value ) === $value;
			}
			if ( is_string( $value ) ) {
				return is_numeric( trim( $value ) );
			}
			if ( is_bool( $value ) ) {
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	);
	$values = array_values( $values );

	$sanitized = rest_sanitize_value_from_schema( $values, $schema, 'values' );

	if ( is_wp_error( $sanitized ) || ! is_array( $sanitized ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	return array_values( array_map( 'intval', $sanitized ) );
}

 * Allow redirects to partner hosts stored in the wpbp_redirect_hosts option.
 * The option is read every time validation runs, so changes apply immediately.

function wpbp_allowed_redirect_hosts( $hosts ) {
    $hosts = (array) $hosts;

    $option = get_option( 'wpbp_redirect_hosts', array() );

    if ( is_string( $option ) ) {
        $option = preg_split( '/[\s,]+/', $option, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
    }

    if ( ! is_array( $option ) ) {
        return $hosts;
    }

    foreach ( $option as $entry ) {
        if ( ! is_string( $entry ) ) {
            continue;
        }

        $entry = trim( $entry );
        if ( '' === $entry ) {
            continue;
        }

        // Accept bare host names, but tolerate full URLs by extracting the host.
        if ( false !== strpos( $entry, '/' ) || false !== strpos( $entry, ':' ) ) {
            $parsed = wp_parse_url( false === strpos( $entry, '//' ) ? '//' . $entry : $entry );
            $entry  = ( is_array( $parsed ) && ! empty( $parsed['host'] ) ) ? $parsed['host'] : '';
        }

        $entry = strtolower( trim( $entry ) );
        if ( '' === $entry ) {
            continue;
        }

        $hosts[] = $entry;
    }

    return array_values( array_unique( $hosts ) );
}

/**
 * Convert a block's style attribute array into inline CSS and preset class names.
 *
 * Preset references (e.g. "var:preset|color|primary") are resolved by the
 * WordPress Style Engine into their custom properties
 * (e.g. "var(--wp--preset--color--primary)").
 *
 * @param array $block_styles Block "style" attribute array.
 * @return array{css:string,classnames:string}
 */
function wpbp_theme_templates_007( array $block_styles ): array {
	$result = array(
		'css'        => '',
		'classnames' => '',
	);

	if ( empty( $block_styles ) || ! function_exists( 'wp_style_engine_get_styles' ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	$styles = wp_style_engine_get_styles( $block_styles );

	if ( ! is_array( $styles ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	if ( ! empty( $styles['css'] ) && is_string( $styles['css'] ) ) {
		$result['css'] = trim( $styles['css'] );
	} elseif ( ! empty( $styles['declarations'] ) && is_array( $styles['declarations'] ) ) {
		$parts = array();
		foreach ( $styles['declarations'] as $property => $value ) {
			if ( '' === $value || null === $value ) {
				continue;
			}
			$parts[] = $property . ':' . $value . ';';
		}
		$result['css'] = implode( ' ', $parts );
	}

	if ( ! empty( $styles['classnames'] ) && is_string( $styles['classnames'] ) ) {
		$classes = preg_split( '/\s+/', trim( $styles['classnames'] ), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );
		$classes = array_unique( array_map( 'sanitize_html_class', $classes ) );
		$classes = array_filter( $classes, 'strlen' );
		$result['classnames'] = implode( ' ', $classes );
	}

	return $result;
}
